== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Gardulla The Hutt (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1274_1</code>, Virtual Block 7 slip p2), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 7.4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-p2-129-Gardulla_The_Hutt.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-gardullathehutt-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Gardulla The Hutt (V)]]; the Master List (2013) reprints the original.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text. Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text (card list):''' “During battle, if [Virtual] No Bargain on table, may lose 2 force to cancel a non-[Immune To Sense] interrupt. Once per game during your move phase, may relocate any of your characters here to any site you occupy as a regular move (or vice versa). Immune to attrition < 3.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1274_1</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark, caption, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB7-p2-129-Gardulla_The_Hutt-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B32 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
